title: the recross proof's ticket tooth patches the ask the inspect judge goes through
intention: test_emit_hands_the_crossing_ticket_to_both_gates patches transitions._ask_inspector, the module global _judge resolves at call time, so its part (b) asserts the asked judge is inspect and carries the crossing ticket, instead of patching inspector.inspect, which now runs in CodeMother's process.
why: Measured 2026-11-14 on akiendelllinux: the proof is red on main 53cff973b and on 15cd72404522's land, 'inspect_build did not pass the ticket: {}'. Since 17d570c10390 @850d9d327 transitions.inspect_build asks over _judge('inspect'), so the monkeypatch of inspector.inspect is never reached. The red blocks 15cd72404522's PROVED close through component_color.
traces_to: Law 8 (a proof must measure the path the code takes), Law 9.
how: D1: part (b) patches transitions._ask_inspector and asserts the asked judge == 'inspect' and kwargs ticket == T; parts (a), (c), (d) are untouched. Built at recross-proof-sees-the-judge @78d5501db.

clauses.claim: test_emit_hands_the_crossing_ticket_to_both_gates part (b) asserts the asked judge is inspect and its kwargs ticket is the crossing ticket, and is green on Linux
the claim is unchanged: emit hands the crossing ticket to both gates; parts (a), (c), (d) are untouched and green
